environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in same VPC. Split.io workspace 'prod-enrichment' has flag 'enable_url_enrichment' with default treatment 'off' and kill switch ENGAGED (flag status: killed). The flag definition has zero targeting rules and zero individual targets. The SDK is initialized with 'localhost' mode disabled, pointing to Split cloud. The factory.block_until_ready() ensures SDK syncs definitions before serving treatments. When a flag is in 'killed' state in Split.io, the SDK deterministically returns the configured default treatment ('off') regardless of user key, evaluation logic, or percentage rollout - this is enforced server-side in the flag definition and cached locally by the SDK's synchronization mechanism. Note: the sanitize_url function still permits http://169.254.169.254 since it only checks scheme.
